evals.prompt: Enrich this GitLab issue before coding: https://gitlab.example.com/group/app/-/issues/88 — people names on existing IPEN screens should show in uppercase; one screen must not wrap date/time columns. Codebase already has those screens.
evals.expected_output: Issue mode: codebase check first, internally. If a real blocking gap exists, chat shows screen facts (no file paths or class names), then each question as Qn with a blank line and `➡️ Recommended:` on the next line (never `sentence. ➡️` on the same line), then ask to reply by number (or all recommended). Questions never go into the GitLab comment. After answers, close requirements in chat (decisions in what changes / acceptance / assumptions). Preview that closed brief in the user's language (Portuguese prompt → Portuguese headings, no English/Portuguese mix), with no Questions section and no Files / areas. Do not call it a PRD. Do not add_issue_comment until the human validates that closed draft. No requirements.md, no Specify, no status change.

evals.prompt: Here is the scope (no GitLab): on the existing People Search screen, add a club filter that lists only active members. Write the implementation brief.
evals.expected_output: Chat mode: if a real gap exists, question batch with Recommended and reply-by-number closer, then close requirements on screen after answers. If no gap, ready brief. No offer to post. No 'want me to post?'. No GitLab comment. No files. No requirements.md. Not a PRD.

evals.prompt: This issue is already clear: Visitas realizadas must not wrap date/time cells; names on Colegas de cela, Visitas realizadas, and Visitas recebidas in uppercase like the rest of the person card. Code matches those screens. Enrich for the coding agent.
evals.expected_output: Ready implementation brief (✅). Current behavior + delta + verifiable acceptance + assumptions. No Files / areas, no paths, no class names. No Questions section. Zero filler questions. Issue URL present → preview only, no post until human yes; chat-only → no post offer. Do not run version Clarify or Specify. Not a PRD.

evals.prompt: Sem GitLab. Escopo: na tela de Reservas, cancelar automaticamente reservas não pagas após 48 horas e liberar a vaga. O gerente pode cancelar manualmente também. Já existe o documento da versão em docs/versions/hotel-v3/pm/decision-register.md.
evals.expected_output: Chat mode, no GitLab offer. Reads docs/versions/hotel-v3/pm/decision-register.md first: answered decisions are not re-asked and appear in the brief as requirements; open decisions this scope touches are asked with the register's recommendation. Runs the business decision scan and rule probes: questions with ➡️ Recomendado on its own line cover at least which time counts for the 48 hours and whether weekends or holidays count (Time), what happens to reservations already pending when this ships (Defaults for existing customers), partially paid reservations (Exceptions), whether a cancellation can be undone (Lifecycle), and who besides the manager may cancel (Roles). These are questions, not silent Assumptions. Does not ask about the algorithm, job scheduler, table or branch. Uses Portuguese throughout (Comportamento atual, O que muda, Aceite, Premissas). After answers, the closed brief has no questions, and one chat line lists decisions that also govern other screens.
